reason: Not notice-only: the ordinance bars terminating a tenancy after 30 days without a listed just cause (at-fault and no-fault causes) and requires relocation assistance for no-fault terminations. Citation uses the ordinance name stated in the document; exemptions, effective date 2021-11-19 and quote match the text.

rule.title: Santa Ana just cause eviction
rule.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rule.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, a Santa Ana landlord must have a just cause listed in the law and state it in a written notice to end your tenancy. For no-fault evictions, the landlord must pay 3 months of relocation assistance or waive the last 3 months of rent.
rule.requirement_es: Después de 30 días de arrendamiento, el propietario en Santa Ana debe tener una causa justa establecida en la ley e indicarla por escrito para terminar su arrendamiento. En desalojos sin culpa, el propietario debe pagar 3 meses de asistencia de reubicación o perdonar la renta de los últimos 3 meses.
rule.coverage_text: Residential tenancies in Santa Ana after 30 days, except housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.

applies_if.value_text: tenancy has lasted more than 30 days

exemptions.label: Housing produced in the last 15 years

rule.quote: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
